goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann kartellrechtliche Maßnahmen und Fusionskontrollen begründen.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native 16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Existing format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: Independent visible bicycle shops contrast with a possible business agreement examined by an authority. Question-mark and barriers frame the question whether intervention is justified rather than claiming that every agreement or merger is forbidden. This is a suitable qualitative prompt for cartel measures and merger review without invented current legal thresholds.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px separate shops, customers, agreement, barriers and inspecting authority remain clear; the large justification question is readable.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px the distinct shop entrances and agreement examination are easily distinguished without small case facts.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The authority holds a magnifier as an inspecting symbol, and customers face the shop interiors correctly; no misoriented legal worksheet or notebook is present.
actualInspection.style: Friendly approachable comic raster, clear broad colors, large conceptual objects; no photorealistic or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: This introductory illustration does not itself identify the legal nature of a specific agreement or distinguish every merger-control instrument. Those distinctions belong to the separately reviewed learning text.
goalTextStatus: Current German competence unchanged in the E2 bilingual candidate; this image review does not attest the positive-evidence profile or bilingual description gate.
